An estimated 50% of SMEs across Dubai indicated that they have a website. This means the other half is not visible, cannot be found online.    Lead generation companies in Dubai sell very different things. Ask any lead generation company in Dubai where the leads come from, who else receives them, and whether the people agreed to be contacted.
